name: DropOut
note: adv_api/filter/dropout.h. DropOut is deterministic: the caller supplies the keep/drop mask (uint8 tensor), not an internal RNG. Byte mode (dropOutMode=0, srcLastAxis==maskLastAxis -> BYTE_ALIGN) computes dst=(1/keepProb)*(float)mask*src. mask all 1, keepProb=0.5, src=3.0 -> dst=6.0.
